nodes.label: Screening Subagent Prompt
nodes.rationale: The prompt body is a complete verified transcription of the screening-verdict and receipt contracts, so the subagent never loads the 900-line schema tree it does not need.

nodes.label: Screening Decision Rules
nodes.rationale: Criteria are evaluated in protocol order and the first failing id recorded; 'unclear' is a legitimate expected output and must not be coerced into 'exclude' to look decisive; outcome positivity is never a screening criterion because null and negative findings are actively wanted; quality is stage 6, not here.

nodes.label: Shared Subagent Output Directory
nodes.rationale: Concurrent screeners write into one directory, so the prompt states this explicitly — otherwise subagents waste turns investigating and auditing their siblings' files.
